objective: Replace the stale owner-setup checkpoint with verified private Phoenix n8n operation while preserving owner and scheduler boundaries.

roles_before.artifact: Hermes, TickTick and ChatGPT queue owners

role_dispositions.destination: Hermes, TickTick and ChatGPT queue owners

capability_probes.assertion: The same existing bridge returns its fixed integration response with valid authentication after restart.
Anonymous REST and MCP return 401, wrong or missing webhook header returns 403, and n8n/noVNC bind loopback.
Caddy PID and restart count remain stable, Hermes gateway active, and three existing nudge services report exit zero with active schedules.
Root-only archive restores an intact SQLite copy, active bridge row, and matching credential material. Prior checkpoint remains in Git.

tests.command: Oracle Phoenix Admin: scoped REST create/read/update/publish, authenticated webhook trigger, local MCP execute and independent execution read-back.
tests.expected: Temporary workflow execution #6 and bridge MCP execution #8 return success; edited workflow response matches.

tests.command: Restart only ron-n8n; check loopback listeners, webhook positive/negative cases, restored backup integrity and existing Caddy/Hermes/nudge service status.
tests.expected: Bridge 200/403, anonymous REST/MCP denied, persisted owner/workflow readable, backup integrity ok, existing runtime owners still active.

known_intentional_losses: Unauthenticated bridge calls are denied. Bridge execution payloads are no longer retained to keep its authentication header out of execution records.
